target: A persistent model-free maintenance queue, explicit desired-versus-actual service state, bounded retries and quarantine, and redacted diagnostics that preserve independent capture.
primary_semantics: Mechanical maintenance becomes observable, idempotent, bounded, and restart-safe while AI remains a one-shot worker for explicitly eligible completed-round semantic jobs.
invariants: Native raw capture continues independently of summary or maintenance failures.
Mechanical eligibility, retry, quarantine, and diagnostics invoke no AI or external service.
A semantic job cannot become runnable before a complete user-assistant round boundary.
Retries are bounded and duplicate delivery cannot duplicate a completed mutation.
Diagnostics exclude secrets, credentials, raw dialogue text, and absolute user paths.
allowed_changes: Add a closed maintenance-job schema and durable queue state machine.
Add desired-versus-actual service status and redacted diagnostic bundles.
Route existing semantic-backfill and backup-debt maintenance through bounded queue claims.
Expose read-only status and explicit repair CLI adapters.
Add fixed MW27 crash, restart, duplicate, permission, stale-lock, capture, round-boundary, redaction, and no-side-effect cases.
prohibited_changes: Continuously invoke AI, infer user intent, or split an incomplete dialogue round.
Activate incoming Rules, Skills, Environment items, or permissions.
Add or alter archive-v1, environment-v1, SSH, or cloud transport protocols.
Rewrite raw history, v2.6 index generations, or existing summary content.
before_after_checks: Hash raw history before and after queue crash, retry, quarantine, and diagnostics.
Restart after each durable state transition and prove idempotent recovery.
Inject duplicate delivery, permission failure, and stale lock without duplicate mutation.
Prove capture telemetry advances while semantic work is failed or quarantined.
Scan every diagnostic bundle for configured secret and path fixtures.
